going_concern.quote: As such, until additional equity or debt capital is secured and the Company begins generating sufficient revenue and operating cash flows, there is substantial doubt about the Company’s ability to continue as a going concern

financing_terms.floating_convertible: The non-interest bearing note is convertible into shares of the Company’s Class A Common Stock at a conversion price equal to 90% of the average VWAP for the five trading days prior to conversion, which was $1.308 per share on March 31, 2025.
financing_terms.equity_line: Also, pursuant to the Amended Finder’s Agreement, the Finder will no longer receive a cash fee for any equity/convertible debt financing except for an equity line of credit in which case the cash fee will be 4%.
